authorization_source: User explicitly approved one bounded offline B14-A repair cycle after the proposed four-hour scope; Strategy Manager accepted the minimal versioned task freeze on 2026-10-13.
purpose: Repair B14-A collector correctness in a separate version and prove actual receive/reconnect/restart/qualification flow with deterministic in-memory synthetic fixtures. No live integration or prospective event admission.
execution_budget_definition: One coherent repair identity, tested through static/import, targeted, adjacent and full deterministic preflight. Repeating identical tests for reproducibility is allowed; a changed executable identity after a failing test consumes the one repair cycle. A recurring failure or further correction beyond that single cycle stops. No Test Executor or Runner jobs.

implementation_contract.form: Separate versioned collector module containing the actual qualification/receive/reconnect/restart flow, driven by explicit transport/clock/persistence interfaces. Synthetic adapters only in this task. No default live adapter or collection CLI; default invocation must fail closed.
implementation_contract.legacy: All v0.1/v0.2/v0.3 collector files, frozen protocols, old freezes, actual state and raw logs remain byte-identical and unread by tests.
implementation_contract.request_id: ASCII alphanumeric 1..32 characters; unique for every connection generation; counter persisted across process restart.
implementation_contract.ack: ACK belongs to current connection generation and request ID, exact trades channel and frozen instrument. Duplicates are idempotent; missing, partial, stale and mismatched ACK cannot ready the session.
implementation_contract.deadline: Monotonic fixed ACK deadline checked before blocking and after every receive, including pong, invalid JSON, unrelated controls and trades. Exact deadline expires. Duplicate/irrelevant traffic cannot extend it.
implementation_contract.gap: Open availability gap from first unready attempt/disconnect; preserve earliest start across failed attempts; close only after successful connect plus all fresh ACKs. Restart retains the open gap; no phantom ready or silent gap closure.
implementation_contract.qualification: Validate exact instId/instType/instFamily/ctType/settleCcy/ctVal/ctValCcy/ctMult against explicit identity expectations; require live state, finite-positive units, exact FUTURES expiry and valid list/expiry timestamp ordering. No discovery, fallback, symbol replacement or inferred live metadata. Synthetic swap expectations are fixture-only and do not establish actual source qualification.
implementation_contract.envelope: Only current generation, fully acknowledged trades envelope with exact allowed arg/row instrument match can reach the legacy-equivalent finite-positive trade parser. Timestamp strings must be integer milliseconds, capture and receive bounds enforced.
implementation_contract.restart: Persist generation/counters/gaps. Session ACK always resets on nonterminal restart. COMPLETE and already-ended REVIEW are terminal no-retry; never reopen September 25.
implementation_contract.immutable_research: B14A_P0_DEFER_DATA stays unchanged. Preserve September 25 IDs/window/T0 and 50 bps hurdle as historical constants, never rescue/reconstruct old data. No headroom or other research calculation.
implementation_contract.endpoint_literal: The new offline-only v0.4 adapter argument uses the prespecified official443 URL wss://ws.okx.com/ws/v5/public. This is an inert literal, not authorization for network access, source acquisition or live integration. The frozen v0.3 :8443 URL and all historical artifacts remain unchanged.

required_synthetic_cases: continuous non-ACK traffic to exact deadline
ACK received after blocking past deadline
failed connect and partial reconnect remain one open gap
gap closes at final fresh ACK, not connect attempt
restart after ready resets ACK and generation
restart while gap open preserves earliest gap
trade envelope instrument mismatch and receive/event bounds
full-flow integration and deterministic repeated result
forbidden_actions: Test Executor or Runner/Runner Probe launch
new prospective event/symbol/source or timing selection
frozen artifact edits or September 25 rescue

result_contract.completion_barrier: Publish report last after exact passing hashes, independent adversarial diff review and current-main revalidation. PASS is offline engineering evidence only; no live deployment, arming, source qualification or research promotion.

clarification_history.reason: Clarify parent-prespecified inert official443 endpoint literal before first test execution; no expansion of research or execution scope.
